basic_info.description: Built in 1937, this light-filled Rousseau style center patio home has been remodeled with the finest attention to detail, offers a wonderful floor plan and boasts spectacular greenery views of Lone Mountain. This gorgeous home offers skylights, parquet floors, high ceilings, vaulted beamed ceilings, plaster moldings and a fabulous woodburning fireplace with intricate detailing. The spacious family room opens out to a private and serene south garden perfect for entertaining and indoor/outdoor living. The chef’s kitchen offers stainless steel appliances and an abundance of custom cabinetry and beautiful granite countertops. Walking distance to USF campus, transportation and easy access to a wide array of delightful amenities.
